title: PERFECT small group tour of The Alhambra
text: This day trip to Granada to explore The Alhambra with Nasrid Palaces was perfect. The communication and responsiveness with Discovering Spain was fantastic. This trip started with prompt pickup by driver Rafa, and our conversation during our drive was wonderful. Our tour guide Enrique was wonderful—informative, hospitable, patient and friendly. We had ample time to explore everything the Alhambra offers—the gardens, the ruins a d Nasrid Palaces. Highly recommend this trip with a small group (ours was 6 people). title: Al Hambra tour with the Palace.
text: Excellent trip and a great guide Enrique. Despite the heat, the tour absolutely great with great overview of history from pick up in Malaga, drive through Granada and finally the Al Hambra. Understanding the journey over the years was great.
author: hemipasc
